$comment: Example BidAwardEnvelope. The holder is the Atum award AUTHORITY did:pkh (the service identity that selected the winning quote), NOT the awarded quote's signer — unlike FulfillmentQuoteEnvelope / PaymentRequestEnvelope. The embedded VC is the quoteAwarder KnownToAtum credential (issuer did:web:atumlabs.xyz, credentialSubject.role `quoteAwarder`) asserting the holder is authorized to award bids. type[] carries the BidAwardEnvelope declaration term (bound into the signature). proof.challenge is award_hash(payment_id, quote_hash, settler_id); proof.domain is the NETWORK-WIDE did:web:<env>.atum.network. The proof jws / VC proofValue below are PLACEHOLDERs (not real signatures) — re-sign with the canonical signer to produce a verifying example.
